notes.title: My Big Sister: Remastered now in Ukrainian! + Save corrupt fix
notes.content:
[b]MY BIG SISTER IS NOW IN UKRAINIAN! [/b]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43088805/6fa5ecaf642ed3f59facba661a4b51bc963a9b89.png[/img]

I would like to personally thank  [ASTRO], Chiliyskiy, MegaMix_Craft and R.Order for volunteering their time and effort to translate My Big Sister: Remastered to Ukrainian. 

As well I have included a small patch alongside it:
[list]
    [*]Fixed a small bug where the bathhouse background music was not looping once returning. 
[/list]

[u]Things currently being worked on: [/u]
[list]
    [*]French translation (afaik)
[/list]

Warning: Updating could result in possible corrupted save files, here's how to fix them!

To fix the save file issue, you will have to revert to a previous update. To do this; right click the game in your Steam library and go to properties, under the beta tab select the dropdown box and select a rollback version (rollbackver0.1 to be precise) until your save files work again

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lOkwsJz.png[/img]

notes.title: It's translations time!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We are in need of volunteer translators/proofreaders/editors to assist us in bringing [b]My Big Sister: Remastered[/b] into your native language!
If you wish to contribute - you can find [u][b]detailed instructions[/b][/u] on our [url=https://github.com/Stranga-Games/My-Big-Sister-Remastered-Translations]Github Repository[/url] and [u][b]collaborate with others[/b][/u] on our [url=https://discord.gg/zvNYeFrbCE]Discord server[/url].
We have both [b]bare files to translate from scratch[/b] and [b]auto-generated translations[/b] which some may find useful for editing/proofreading purposes. 

[b]Any and all contributions are greatly appreciated and will be added to the game's credits accordingly![/b]
[b]We look forward to working with you![/b] :heart:

- [b]MegaMix_Craft[/b] & [b]Stranga[/b]
